# Time.ms

> Atomic clock service providing precise UTC/GMT time synchronization with millisecond accuracy and network information tools.

Time.ms is a real-time atomic clock service that delivers exact time synchronization for applications requiring high precision. The platform combines UTC/GMT time services with network utilities including IP geolocation, ASN lookup, and device time validation.

## Key Topics

- Atomic Clock
- UTC Time
- GMT
- Unix Timestamp
- Millisecond Synchronization
- Time Synchronization
- Timezone Conversion
- IP Address
- IPv4
- IPv6
- Geolocation API
- ASN Lookup
- Network Information

## Atomic Time Services

- [Time.ms - Exact Time Atomic Clock](https://time.ms): Atomic clock service providing precise UTC/GMT time with millisecond synchronization for applications requiring high-precision timekeeping
